prompt.project_info: Create an ethereal cinematic stage-fashion portrait in cool blue haze with a focused performance presence.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional female performer with original non-celebrity features, long dark voluminous waves, dewy realistic skin, soft smoky eyeshadow, winged eyeliner, gradient red lips, and a sharp focused gaze. She wears a textured white lace fashion top with high-waisted black pleated bottoms and a delicate silver necklace.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-contrast stage spotlights with a cool blue rim light along hair and skin, cinematic fog, ethereal concert atmosphere balancing vulnerability and power.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical 504:1002-style composition, sharp facial and fabric detail, realistic skin texture, controlled motion in hair, cinematic stage photography.
